Your Guide

Andrew Allen Porteous

Trainer, coach, and practicing alchemist focused on practical personal transformation — purpose, performance, and aligned action. Andrew left banking and New Zealand for Ambassador University in Texas at 24, became financially independent at 40, and has spent over 35 years walking his own path of financial understanding, self-development, and spiritual awareness.

Today he lives at Oak Meadows, a horse ranch in Rheurdt, Germany, with his wife of more than 25 years and their 3 children — teaching simple systems that reduce overwhelm and increase follow-through.

Codex of Transformation

From Financial Pain to Financial Gain

The Gateway · Tin – Ignorance
"I don't know that I don't know."

All I know is that I am in pain. I am frustrated that I never get ahead, no matter what I do. I am in debt over my head, and things just seem to always get worse. I have tried saving but used the money for an "emergency". I am too proud to ask for help, but really don't know where to turn. No one reading this, is at this level, because you are here at Alchemists Well. That means you are at least at level 2. Tin is a state. There are no modules or learning criteria because as soon as you realise the definition fits you, and you are here, at Alchemist Well, paying member or not, you are aware there is more to learn.

Short Assessment Criteria

Can Tick more than 5 out of 10 as being true

  • I am not happy with my current financial situation
  • Not only am I not happy, but recently I have experienced some form of dissatisfaction and/or frustration regarding a money topic.
  • I currently do not have any real savings to speak of, or I tried but money never seems to stay around
  • I often feel struck with my forward momentum in life
  • I do not have written goals or a written purpose statement
  • I have no financial education apart from what my parents said about money, which was negative
  • I do not use a budget at all
  • I am in debt
  • There is more month at the end of the money, than money at the end of the month
  • I have never heard of "Alchemy" and would not know what to do with it if I had.
